evidence.detail: rs/n/c/d/a builds the same raid navigation shell around exact roots 32300, 32297, 32299, 32298 and 32600. The shell contains 'Party', 'Public / Join', 'Invocations' and three 'Select tab' controls over raids/bg.

The class loads exact raid navigation resources raids/tabactive, raids/tabinactive and raids/tabdisabled plus raids/sprite 1-4 and raids/owner, then updates the active/disabled tab sprites and label colors through one shared tab-selection method.

Its initialization composes the shell with already-reviewed raid content: rs/n/c/d/c RaidPartyHubInterface, rs/n/c/d/b RaidPartyListInterface and rs/n/c/d/e AfflictionTomesInterface, proving that the class is shared navigation rather than a duplicate content interface.

The class wraps multiple distinct raid content roots through rs/n/d/c containers, finalizes each composite tree, and registers raid overlay consumers at widgets 32317, 32465 and 32486. This is a cross-surface shell/controller role, not one page's body.
R123 ScriptPacket 41 directly updates rs/n/c/d/a state and calls its tab-selection refresh path, independently confirming that this class owns live raid navigation/tab state.

proposals.note: RaidNavigationInterface is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the shared tabbed shell used across the recovered raid party/list/invocation surfaces. The role is fixed by multi-root composition, exact tab resources/labels and ScriptPacket 41 state updates; no original source identifier is claimed. Confidence is 0.999.
